svg.text: LAUNCH FILM · STORYBOARD V2 · SAAS LAUNCH CUT

g.text: V2 · SHOT 09 — EVERY FRAME. WATCHED BY A PERSON.

svg.text: Every frame. Watched by a person.
Statement, two lines. "person." in brand green, held inside the brackets.
Line one cuts on; line two rises through a mask; brackets draw around "person." last.
"Every frame. Before you ever see it."

g.text: V2 · SHOT 10 — COMPARE: TOOL VS BREW

svg.text: Full-bleed split with a draggable divider. Left: the stock skyline a tool picks when
the narration says "Rose Freedman". Right: her actual 1911 photograph on paper. The
Divider wipes from right to left over 1.6s, revealing the archive photo. Left half
"An AI tool picks on mood. We find her."
Paper slide; shutter click when the divider settles.

g.text: Why the Panama Canal Ran Short of…
Why Your Diet Starts on Monday
The 1904 Olympic Marathon in St L…

svg.text: The Library screen at a steep isometric angle: ten delivered films across nine styles
(explainer, archive, stick, cartoon, brainrot). Thumbnails glow faintly.
Camera glides diagonally across the grid (crane + pan), 3s, parallax between window
and glow. One card lifts on hover.
"Long-form YouTube, any style, up to sixty minutes."
Language dropdown opens in the same window.

g.text: Upload it nine times, not once.

svg.text: Languages screen: same player, a language list on the right (exactly the nine on the
site). The selection steps EN → DE → FR while the waveform reshapes and the picture
Selection highlight steps down on each beat. Waveform morphs per language. Small
floating chip: "Upload it nine times, not once."
The same VO phrase, crossfading through languages.
Window swaps to the teal b-roll screen (shared-element on the player).
